name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel chart
description: How many make it through each stage, with the conversion and the drop-off between stages in words.

FunnelChartStage.description: One stage's drawing, hidden from screen readers (the stage that holds it carries its name). The words on top (horizontal) or at the start (vertical): the label and the count, with its share of the first when `showConversion` is `'first'` or `'both'` (not on the first stage). Then its piece of the funnel: a chart/3 shape whose thickness follows its share of the first, edge to edge, easing to the next stage's. With `active` its whole area lights up. Under the shape (horizontal), centred on the stage, or after it (vertical), level with its middle, sits the step to the `next` stage (`[data-slot="funnel-chart-step"]`, not on the last stage, nor with `showConversion="first"`): the share lost on the way ("↓ 75%"), under the piece of the flow that narrows. The tooltip points at `[data-slot="funnel-chart-marker"]`, level with the middle of the shape: at the column's end (its start on the last stage) or, vertical, at the middle of the row, so it never covers the words. Spans only, so it can sit in a button. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root `span`.

props.name: nextShare
props.description: The next stage's share of the first (0–1): the shape eases to it across the stage. Default: the stage's own, flat.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes the count. Default: the number in `dateLocale`.

props.name: active
props.description: This stage is on show: its area lights up.

props.name: dimmed
props.description: Another stage is on show: the shape fades to 30% of its colour on the card, as BarChart's other bars do.

props.name: enter
props.description: Fades the shape in from 95% of its thickness, once, when it mounts.

props.name: next
props.description: The next stage: under this one (after it, vertical) the step says the share lost on the way there, where the flow narrows.

FunnelTable.description: The funnel as a table: stage, count, from previous, from first, drop-off. The Funnel chart renders one, visually hidden unless `showTable`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `table`.

props.name: caption
props.description: The table's caption, the chart's title.

props.name: visible
props.description: Shown on the page; otherwise only screen readers get it.

props.name: dropOffWarning
props.description: Share of the previous stage lost that marks a big drop-off. Default 0.5.

FunnelChart.description: The funnel in its card. See the block comment above for the anatomy, states and keys. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's root `div`.

props.name: range
props.description: The dates the funnel covers, under the title (or the KPI).

props.name: format
props.description: Writes the counts ("€48,000"). Default: the number in `dateLocale`.

props.name: showConversion
props.description: Which conversions to show: from the previous stage (the step under the flow), from the first (after each count), or both. Default 'previous'.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Rows (default) or columns.

props.name: dropOffWarning
props.description: Share of the previous stage lost (0–1) that turns the step amber with a warning icon and adds "big drop-off". Default 0.5.

props.name: showTable
props.description: Shows the data table under the funnel; it is always in the DOM for screen readers.

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton rows at the height of five stages.

props.name: empty
props.description: The empty state's title when `stages` is empty. Default "No data".

props.name: error
props.description: Shows the reason in place of the funnel, read out politely; `true` says "Couldn't load".

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Adds Retry to the error.

props.name: onStageSelect
props.description: Makes every stage a button.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Index of the stage shown as hovered (state sheets, docs).

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: No entrance, as under prefers-reduced-motion.
